title: It kept stopping to check itself. Watch.
caption:
OpenAI added six new languages to ChatGPT's voice feature and removed the hesitation pauses.

GPT-Live-1.1 now supports French, German, Hindi, Mexican Spanish, Korean, and Japanese.
The update also removes the 'checking...' delays that interrupted voice conversations.
Rolling out today to all users, with API access coming soon.
